Mind you, Negan brutally murdered Maggie's husband, Glenn Rhee, with his barbed-wire baseball bat, Lucille, in The Walking Dead season 7 premiere. IYKYK

Viewers never expected to see Maggie defending or aligning with Negan to this extreme degree after everything they've been through. It really is one of the most shocking evolutions in the entire franchise. Maggie Rhee aligning with Negan Smith in The Walking Dead: Dead City subverted almost every fan's expectations, given their brutal history.

What started as a bitter quest for revenge over Glenn's death has evolved into a complicated survival bond. Recent episodes feature moments like Hershel stepping in to help them escape, showing a massive generational shift in how the past is handled.
